notes:
Zaiqa Billing, Zaiqa Waiter, Zaiqa Kitchen, Zaiqa Stock and Zaiqa Staff apps, version 2.35.2.

Zaiqa Staff roles, fingerprint and admin check-out
- Each person now has a job: Waiter, Delivery boy, Chef, Helper, Kitchen helper, Cashier, Manager. It shows in the staff app and the POS.
- Delivery boys can check OUT from anywhere (they deliver far away). Everyone else must be within the restaurant radius (default 100 m, so 500 m away is refused). Check-in is always at the restaurant.
- Nobody is checked out automatically because of distance.
- Admin: new "Check out" button on the Today board to close anyone who left without permission (reason is saved).
- Staff app: sign in with fingerprint next time.
